content.value_statement: Video campaign workflows can confuse template readiness, generation, delivery, and creative quality. This skill guides authorized Shuffll Engage operations using current tool schemas and verified results.
actual_capabilities: Discover exposed MCP tools, current schemas, and the intended authorized organization before making changes.
Inspect published templates and versions for render readiness while preserving the user's template selection.
Guide authorized campaign creation, recipient input, and requested generation as separate actions.
Apply operation identifiers, revision checks, pagination cursors, and polling guidance to campaign workflows.
Inspect generation jobs and actual results while distinguishing media completion from delivery or engagement.
Guide supported creative journeys and verify saved choices, playable previews, and final exports before making quality claims.
limitations: Requires a configured Shuffll Engage connection and appropriate credentials; operations vary by grants, entitlements, and release.
Legacy flat-video-v1 generation does not personalize media from recipient names, segments, or contact fields alone.
Video generation does not establish message delivery, views, or engagement; delivery requires a separately supported and authorized operation.
Creative effects require exposed tools and verification; preview appearance does not prove final MP4 parity.

use_cases.title: Evaluate templates before a campaign
use_cases.description: Inspect available templates, identify render-ready versions, and explain whether supported inputs can provide the requested personalization.

use_cases.title: Recover an uncertain generation request
use_cases.description: Inspect existing jobs after a timeout and determine whether an identical retry can reuse the original operation identifier.

use_cases.title: Verify a creative preview
use_cases.description: Review supported music, captions, overlays, and transitions against saved state and playable output before reporting export quality.

prompt_templates.title: Browse available templates
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my authorized Shuffll Engage templates and identify versions that are ready to render. Do not create or generate anything.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a campaign without rendering
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a campaign using my selected render-ready template version. Use the connected authorized organization, and do not add recipients, start generation, or send messages.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: separate campaign setup from paid generation.

prompt_templates.title: Recover after a generation timeout
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the existing campaign and job after my generation request timed out. Determine whether the original action completed before proposing any retry or additional spend.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: reconcile state before retrying a mutation.

prompt_templates.title: Review creative finishing and export evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this journey's saved music, captions, overlays, and transitions using exposed tools. Compare playable preview and final export evidence, and report unverified features without regenerating assets.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: verify creative claims across preview and final output.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Create a campaign without generating or sending videos.
output: Campaign created using the selected ready template version.
Generation has not started, and no messages have been sent.
Next step: provide authorized inputs and request generation when ready.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Does this preview prove the final video has working captions and transitions?
output: The preview alone does not establish final MP4 parity.
Caption timing must match the actual paired performance.
Transitions require evidence for the current effect, scene shape, and release.
Final export verification is still required before confirming these features.

best_practices: Resolve the authorized organization and inspect current tool schemas before making changes.
Use synthetic recipients for demonstrations and keep credentials and recipient details out of diagnostic logs.
Inspect saved state and real outputs before claiming generation success, personalization, delivery, or final export quality.
anti_patterns: Treating a recipient segment label as a complete authorized recipient list.
Starting another paid generation after a timeout without checking existing state and authorization.
Assuming catalog entries, preview playback, or completed generation prove applied effects, export parity, or message delivery.

faq.question: What connection does this skill require?
faq.answer: It uses configured Shuffll Engage MCP tools and references REST documentation. Authenticate through supported OAuth or private credential settings.

faq.question: Can I reuse other Shuffll API credentials?
faq.answer: Existing Shuffll video-production API credentials are not interchangeable with Engage credentials.

faq.question: Does creating a campaign start generation?
faq.answer: No. Campaign creation and generation are separate actions. Generation requires a ready source, required inputs, and user authorization.

faq.question: Does adding recipient information personalize the video?
faq.answer: Not by itself. The legacy flat-video-v1 route produces fixed video; personalization requires supported journey or template inputs and output verification.

faq.question: What happens after a generation timeout?
faq.answer: Inspect existing job or resource state first. Reuse the operation identifier only for an uncertain retry with identical input.

faq.question: Can the skill confirm delivery and creative quality?
faq.answer: Delivery requires separate supported evidence. Creative quality claims require inspecting playable outputs and verifying relevant features in the final export.
